name: bmm_chunk
description: Per-chunk batched Gram matrix with signature bmm_chunk(a, b, chunk_size, causal=False). a and b have shape [batch, seqlen, ngroups, k] with seqlen divisible by chunk_size. Split the token axis into chunks and compute, for every batch, chunk, group and row pair (i,j), out[..., i, j] = sum_k a[batch, chunk*chunk_size+i, group, k] * b[batch, chunk*chunk_size+j, group, k]. The native output is newly allocated with shape [batch, seqlen//chunk_size, ngroups, chunk_size, chunk_size] and dtype a.dtype. causal=False computes all tiles; causal=True uses the causal tile schedule and stores only entries with i > j, zeroing i <= j. The causal suite treats only its selected triangular region as specified. The exercised dtype is bfloat16; inputs are not modified.
